chapter: Leaving St. Louis: Toby show, Darrell Harris and Eli Rice
title: Why he left St. Louis; tuba player Willy Berel's offer
summary: Thomas saw no opportunities in St. Louis and had no wish to go to New Orleans. Tuba player Willy Berel from a Toby show invited him on tour.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, don't come to him yet. What I want to know is Louis how you come to leave St. Louis? Who did you leave St. Louis with?

Well, I had to go leave. There were no opportunities epper there, I didn't think. Not for me at least, I think. The boats were and those and those things. And New Orleans in didn't gass me. To go to New Orleans, you know, the boat that goes to New Orleans didn't gass me no matter what the score was.
Did you ever play on any of those riverboats?

No, never. I think the people who played on them were wonderful water logged (?). I went in another direction, you know. So, during that course, one of those nights, I thought St. Louis was New Orleans better. Why go to Stxxxxkxxxx? That's further south, it can't be any better. So I'm looking for improvement and not for any (yuk-yuk.) So during the course of that night, Tubas were Tip was kind of prominent, you know, bass horn? and there was a fellow by the name of Willy Berel. Should never forget him. He was working with the Tariff Show, the Toby Trophy Show.

Yeah. And he's getting ready to leave. His wife was a dancer and she worked with, I can't remember who. So he was getting ready to leave town and he liked my little work. So we got to talking and he said, "Well, how would you like to make a little tour with us?" I said, "Sound fine to me. My levee is closed." Cecil Scott, we'd had gone from the Congo Roof to another little ballroom. And the ballroom was -- some little thing happened there. We'd bring the shows on a Thursday night from the Booker T. Washington Theater and we'd play the acts.
Yeah, I see, in the ballroom.
